# Introduction

Geirrhafa is an aggressive miniboss found in Mountains inside Howling Caverns. He looks exactly like a Cultist, but his fur is white and his cloak is black with red tints.

### Drops

• Item: Hildir's silver chest | 0 Star: 1

• Item: Geirrhafa trophy | 0 Star: 100%

### Ice claw double

Geirrhafa swings his claws twice in a 3-meter 90-degree horizontal arc (60 Slash and 70 Frost damage for each hit). This attack has a 10-second cooldown and can be used when a player is within 1.5 meters.

### Ice claw

Geirrhafa swings his claw once in a 3-meter 90-degree horizontal arc (40 Slash and 60 Frost damage). This attack has a 2-second cooldown and can be used when a player is within 1.5 meters.

### Frost

Creates a 4-meter 35-degree conical blast of frosty mist which cannot be blocked (100 Frost damage). This ability has a 10-second cooldown and is accessible when a player is within 2–6 meters, making it possible to disable by standing close.

### Ice nova

Every 15 seconds, he can slam his hands into the ground, creating three circular shockwaves that pulse outward 5 meters every 1.46 seconds (90 Frost damage each). These shockwaves are not dodgeable or blockable. He can do this when a player is within 7 meters.

## Notes

• Geirrhafa seems to be an ice counterpart to the cultist.
• Geirrhafa seems to have been cursed.
